correctness.rationale: With down-set S of k spins, exact induced-edge formula H_h=40-16h+(2h-10)k+4e(S) follows from degree 5 and 40 edges. Independent exhaustive integer count over all 2^16 masks on folded-cube generators 1,2,4,8,15 finds independent-set polynomial 1+16z+80z^2+160z^3+120z^4+16z^5; min e(k) for k=6,7,8 is 2,3,4 with 400,80,10 minimizers. Structural argument using alpha=5 and pairwise maximum-independent-set intersections rules out intermediate envelope sectors; -3 Walsh eigenvalue yields exactly 10 zero-field ground states. Independent lower envelope checks yield h=0 count10, h=7/3 count26, h=3 count16, h=5 count393, h=6 count1. Global spin reversal gives negative h. Enumeration is exhaustive for this fixed 16-vertex graph; it does not prove a higher-dimensional analogue.
